newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to license cable modem technology.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to license cable modem technology.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Thursday it will offer royalty-free cross-licenses for patents to the CyberSURFR standard for cable modem equipment.
The royalty-free licensing program is designed to accelerate the definition and standardization of a high-speed data-over-cable protocol, the company said.
Also, Motorola is offering the opportunity for qualified vendors to cross-license patents, it said.
Motorola said it is currently working with component manufacturers to ensure widespread availability of components that support the Motorola cable modem technology.

It said it believes companies benefiting from this free license should be committed to keeping the standard open, rather than taking advantage of the license while blocking other companies with their essential patents.
